scope: E53: final macOS test.run OS restrictions plus effective protection of cxf startup environment; repeated independent matched overhead, no model inference/cloud in timing
validation_source_change_reason: After timing, only cxf.sh help/examples were updated to describe permissions. Runtime, Native tests and benchmark sources are byte-identical to timing. The wrapper help path was not used by the timing runner.

method.baseline: Current explicit isolation off, same fixed command and minimal environment; not a reconstruction of E51 binaries
method.candidate: Default Seatbelt isolation; private TMPDIR/HOME; workspace read-only except explicit write grant for system_cc_compile_write
method.order: Alternate off/on order by repetition and case; API8 then256, CLI afterwards. API off after warmup shares the sticky host protection; CLI uses fresh processes and includes cold host verification. File-count groups are not randomized, so do not infer causal scaling solely across groups.
method.cli_primary: Two scripted loopback HTTP model choices per task; actual agentctl registry, tool execution, receipt and final response
method.units: Milliseconds; cost = on minus off; positive means slower
method.inner_clock: C probe monotonic timer around a real child shell and command; outside-inner is computed per matched pair before aggregation
method.parent_profile: Prepare covers profile construction and bounded inode/hardlink scan; actual Seatbelt application happens in child, included with spawn/exec/polling in outside-inner
method.memory: Fixed73880-byte job in both modes; host verification additionally uses up to262144-byte transient heap and a trusted fork once per process; no RSS/child peak/KV claim
method.clock_oracle: All recorded commands passed and inner timers were present; output truncation/error not hidden
method.source_scope: Source hashes describe measured revision; only later wrapper help text differs in final validation

host_environment_control.scope: Only cxf current host startup environment; no claim about other same-UID processes

Narrow read filters alone still exposed parent environment; effective CS_RESTRICT host protection and SIP gate were required
macOS sysctl test needed Darwin header features; repaired probe and retained off positive control

limits: Only this macOS Seatbelt plus SIP/CS_RESTRICT host-verification backend is accepted; deprecated system mechanism. Linux/Windows backends pending and default commands fail closed there.

Explicit isolation off removes OS file/network boundaries. Network allow is broad, not per-host policy. No loopback-only promise or real cloud/network quality test. Other same-UID process environments and visible argv are outside the host-protection guarantee.
Known credentials/pattern admission still follows D-DATA; not arbitrary-secret DLP, VM isolation, hostile same-user race protection or resource-usage containment.
Metadata reads are globally allowed except protected paths; content reads remain bounded. Trusted OS/selected standard toolchain directories are read-only grants.

Standard Xcode cc has a large measured slowdown. Most paired extra time is inside command; cache/IPC causes not isolated. Explicit CLT is a separate workload, not proof of the same compiler running faster.
CLI timing includes process startup, local HTTP stubs and real tool execution; no real model decisions, inference, cloud traffic or streaming speedup claim.
Small single-machine samples, scheduling tails and negative pairs retained. Medians of phase differences must not be added together.
Job capacity is shared off/on; host probe transient allocation is a bound, not a measured RSS peak. Child/system tool memory peaks and pure Seatbelt compilation time unmeasured.
Execution timeout starts after parent preparation; scan/profile work is bounded separately. Temporary cleanup failure reports io_error and does not rerun side-effecting commands.
Precompiled upstream libraries and OS programs are outside sanitizer coverage; six pre-existing native harness compiler warnings retained.
Old53 evidence files and38 figure pairs stay unchanged. E53 overhead is not added to or subtracted from older inference gains.
